topic: Report export granularity and data limitations
summary_markdown:
Discussion covered two main technical issues. First, when running session forecasts for periods lacking historical data (e.g., missing hours), one option discussed was to 'forecast back' fresh data by completely faking the missing hours.
Second, a report issue was identified: When exporting reports from the traffic dashboard with hour granularity over a large date range (e.g., 1 year), the exported file sometimes defaults to day granularity. It was determined this is not intentional and may be due to client-side issues where long reports cause browser freezing during JSON to XSLT conversion.
decisions: The issue of report export defaulting to day granularity for large date ranges will be reported via a ticket.
action_items: Create an IT ticket detailing the steps to reproduce the report export failure, including the specific dashboard and data range.
